authoring.note: Made from the real building 1f8286ae91b380dd (a strip about 334 m by 4 m), picked by Ingram in the Location Editor on 2026-10-05, who said it is a train platform and not Baggage Inspection (canon/decisions/D064.md). The name is Claude's, from where it lies, and is open (open-questions.json#seaward-platform-name). It replaces the location baggage-inspection, whose text is kept here in case any of it is wanted again: 'A long shed beside the barrier where bags are opened on trestle tables. Two inspectors on a normal day and six when something has happened. Anything that cannot be explained in one sentence goes into a numbered tray and comes back at the end of the working week, or does not. Regulars pack accordingly: one bag, nothing wrapped, nothing sealed.'

lore.summary: A train platform: a long, narrow strip about 330 metres by 4, running along the seaward flank of the Transfer Hall and on past its end. It is a platform of its own, apart from the Mainland Platforms and the Island Platforms.
